approach: The catalogs stay byte-identical: older validators read them as immutable inputs and many authority records pin them. This reviewed overlay gives the banking-era view; scripts/sector_catalog.py applies it as exact, counted substring replacements and refuses any mismatch. Banking-era consumers read catalogs only through it.

deferred.reason: artifact.platform.industry-pack is a REPOSITORY_PACKET implementation bound to deliverable 0 of the published packet IND-WG-005, and validate_readiness requires a published task packet whose allowedPaths cover the implementation path. IND-BANK-005 is an unpublished successor proposal, so the banking manifest path cannot be bound yet. CONTRACT_ONLY is not admissible either: the profile fixtures profile.banking-readonly-amd64 (base identifier profile.whitegoods-readonly-amd64; selectedModules, expectedClosure) and profile.foundation-airgap-k3s-arm64 (expectedClosure) use the module. The entry changes when IND-BANK-005 is published.
